I owe so much to all the faculty members of the Crescent School who shaped my personality and trained my brain.
Crescent School played a key role in my life. It was my first step to the road of success. In my experience, Crescent is the finest example of expanding horizons and excellence in action.

Looking back I loved the time I spent at the Crescent. When I came for the entrance test, I was amazed at how big the school was. I sat in the gymnasium and was very impressed with the facilities that Crescent offered. I was an average, shy student but developed during my time at Crescent.

Crescent Model School is an institution in every sense of the word. I remember Crescent for the warmth and affection of the teachers, the discipline and rigors of the sports field, the excitement and the inspiration of the debating and the declamation contests. It is a delight to see Crescent flourishing and moving forward to maintain its position as a center for excellence for primary to secondary education in the fast moving world of the 21st Century.

Whether you just graduated or it’s been a while, your time with Crescent hasn’t come to an end. Crescent will always stay a hub of fond memories and experiences for you. At Crescent, we define our future while embracing a tradition of more than 50 years in the making. Our mission shapes our vision. But our alumni and friends — our one-of-a-kind community — YOU make that vision a reality. You will always stay a strong part of Crescent’s extraordinary story. Together, we will keep Crescent thriving and prepare a new generation to lead the way. Once upon a time, most of the best practices for alumni engagement revolved around direct mail campaigns, phone calls and student reunions. Now the digital age means we can engage with our alumni on a more consistent and modern basis.
At Crescent School, we are inspired by values that make each student of ours rise to their potential

The following are strictly prohibited and students found guilty of them are liable to be withdrawn from the school.
Keeping explosives, knives or weapons of any sort
Carrying mobile phones to the school
To withdraw a student from school the guardian/parent must give a one month written notice prior to the student’s last day at the school.
The leaving student must attend school for a month during notice period.
Application form (available at the school office) for security refund is to be submitted by the parents
Security refund is paid through a cross cheque approximately within a month of the child’s withdrawal.
